description: Test suite for npm-resolution helper functions using Vitest, testing resolution logic, mapping, and record building for npm package specifications.

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Defines a test suite for 'npm-resolution helpers'.

methods.name: it
methods.description: Defines individual test cases within the test suite.

methods.name: expect
methods.description: Assertion function used to verify test outcomes.

methods.name: installedPluginRoot
methods.description: Helper function to generate plugin installation paths.

methods.name: buildNpmInstallRecordFields
